reproduction_target: Multi-ancestry / multi-biobank polygenic risk score (PRS) training and evaluation pipeline: from All of Us (AoU v7 WGS, ~245k) and Pan-UK Biobank GWAS summary statistics, through ancestry assignment, GWAS (Regenie), cross-biobank meta-analysis (METAL), genetic-architecture estimation (SBayesS/LDSC/GCTA/Popcorn), PRS construction (P+T, PRS-CS, PRS-CSx), Fst/individual-PRS-accuracy, evaluated across AFR/AMR/EUR/EAS/CSA target groups. Secondary analysis of existing biobank data; no wet-lab in scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from Methods prose only. NO code/data availability statement in the preprint; no repository (GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo) named for this paper's analysis code. The only GitHub URL in the XML (narechan/khill_complexity) belongs to a cited reference, not this study. All named tools are standard public software but authors' driver scripts are not shared and versions are almost entirely absent (only 'PLINK 2.0' as a loose major version). Data are AoU (controlled-access via Researcher Workbench) + Pan-UKB (public GWAS release).

steps.label: Genetic-ancestry assignment — PCA projection onto HGDP+1000G reference (168,899 pre-estimated variant weights) + random-forest classification (prob>50%) + centroid-distance outlier pruning; no named software or version
Regenie — GWAS on AoU AFR/AMR/EUR training datasets (HapMap3 variants; covariates age, sex, first 10 PCs); no version
METAL — inverse-variance-weighted cross-biobank/cross-ancestry meta-analysis of AoU + UKB GWAS; no version
PLINK — clumping to define top genome-wide-significant loci for variance-explained calculation (ancestry-matched UKB reference panels); no version
SBayesS — polygenicity estimation (Bayesian mixed linear model, default settings) on UKB EUR GWAS; no version
LDSC — LD-score-regression SNP-heritability and genetic-correlation (r_g) estimates on AoU EUR GWAS; no version
GCTA-GREML — restricted-maximum-likelihood heritability from individual-level downsampled AoU/UKB data (covariates age, sex, 10 PCs); no version
Popcorn — cross-ancestry genetic-correlation (EUR/AFR, EUR/AMR from AoU) using 1000 Genomes reference panels; no version
PRS-CS — Bayesian genome-wide PRS (auto model, default MCMC: 1000 iterations, 500 burn-in, thinning 5) with software-provided UKB LD matrices; no version
PRS-CSx — multi-ancestry Bayesian PRS (auto model) with software-provided UKB LD matrices; no version
Pruning-and-thresholding (P+T) PRS — LD r2 threshold 0.1, p-value grid (5e-8 ... 1), pre-computed UKB LD matrices; validation/test split for threshold tuning; PLINK-based, no version
PLINK 2.0 — Wright's Fst ("wc" method, 168,899 pruned variants) and PRS scoring (--score, 100 sets of posterior effects); loose major version 'PLINK 2.0' only, no exact pin
SCOPE — per-individual continental-ancestry-proportion inference for European-ancestry-quintile stratification; no version

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: NI ceiling on all 13/13 computational steps. R★ not assignable at stage1, and RI is also unreachable at prose level because the paper publishes NO analysis code (no repository, no code-availability statement) and almost NO software versions (only a loose 'PLINK 2.0' major version). Every step relies on standard public tools with documented parameters, but without the authors' driver scripts and without version pins the version axis is 0 for all steps, driving axis-min to 0 (NI). Even a stage-2 code read is not possible (nothing to read). This is not a stage2_candidate. To lift steps toward RI, the authors would need to publish their analysis pipeline plus a versioned software manifest / environment lock.
headline.coverage: 13 computational steps assessed from Methods prose (AoU/Pan-UKB secondary analysis). No wet-lab in scope (WGS generated by the AoU and UKB programs, not this study; W=0).

gaps.missing: The preprint contains no code-availability statement and names no repository (GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo/Software Heritage) for the PRS training/evaluation pipeline. Authors' driver scripts, config, and glue code are unavailable; only the underlying third-party tools are public.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the analysis pipeline (scripts + configs orchestrating Regenie/METAL/PRS-CS/PRS-CSx/PLINK/etc.) in a versioned public repository with a code-availability statement.

gaps.missing: No conda env / lockfile / Docker / Singularity / environment-modules manifest anywhere. No reproducible environment specification is provided.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a conda-lock/pixi.lock or container digest for a declared OS/arch covering all named tools.

gaps.missing: Versions are essentially absent: Regenie, METAL, PLINK (clumping), SBayesS, LDSC, GCTA, Popcorn, PRS-CS, PRS-CSx, SCOPE have NO version; only 'PLINK 2.0' is given as a loose major version. Reference-panel and HGDP/1000G weight versions are also unpinned.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a tool-version manifest (exact versions/commits) for every named piece of software and for the reference panels/LD matrices used.

gaps.missing: AoU v7 WGS and individual-level phenotypes are controlled-access (obtainable only via the AoU Researcher Workbench under an approved workspace); no public accession. Exact participant subsets, kinship exclusions and QC thresholds are described in prose but not shipped as a reproducible sample manifest.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide, within the Researcher Workbench, a sample/ID manifest and QC/split scripts so an approved researcher can regenerate the exact training/test partitions.

gaps.missing: Ancestry assignment (PCA projection + random forest + centroid-distance outlier removal via histogram inspection) is described narratively with no named software, no version, and a manual outlier-cutoff step ("excluding individuals at the extreme high end"), making it non-deterministically specified.
gaps.how_to_close: Release the ancestry-assignment code with fixed thresholds/seeds and the exact HGDP+1000G weight file version.
